sum: Darkiris Inc., through its subsidiaries, develops, publishes, operates, markets, and distributes mobile games on various platforms in Hong Kong, Macau, and Taiwan. The company engages in game design, programming, and graphics activities. It is also involved in video marketing on social media and video content platforms. The company offers its products through various third-party digital storefronts. Darkiris Inc. was founded in 2017 and is headquartered in Sheung Wan, Hong Kong.
